title: Bhakti
description: A term associated with devotion and devotional orientation across multiple textual and living traditions.

title: Brahman
description: A central philosophical term with differing interpretations across traditions; this record is intentionally introductory.

title: Chandas
description: The study of meter in Sanskrit textual traditions, with applications and interpretations that depend on the text being studied.

title: Dharma
description: A sample concept record whose meanings and contexts require careful distinction between traditional accounts, historical scholarship and modern interpretation.

title: Jñāna
description: A term for knowledge or insight whose meaning differs across philosophical and devotional contexts.

title: Jyotiṣa
description: A Vedāṅga category associated with calendrical and astral knowledge in historical textual contexts.

title: Kalpa
description: A domain associated with procedural and ritual textual traditions, including different sūtra contexts.

title: Karma
description: A sample concept record for a source-aware treatment of action and consequence across different contexts.

title: Moksha
description: A sample concept record for a future treatment of liberation across philosophical contexts.

title: Nirukta
description: A domain of etymological and semantic explanation associated with Vedic study.

title: Puruṣārtha
description: A framework commonly discussed through aims of human life; details vary by textual and interpretive context.

title: Saṃsāra
description: A concept whose uses and interpretations vary across texts and philosophical traditions.

title: Śikṣā
description: A Vedāṅga concerned with phonetics and pronunciation in textual learning; detailed traditions and pedagogical contexts vary.

title: Vairāgya
description: A term associated with detachment or dispassion, interpreted differently across philosophical contexts.

title: Vyākaraṇa
description: The grammatical study of Sanskrit and related linguistic analysis, represented here as a Vedāṅga domain.

title: Yoga
description: A term with philosophical, contemplative and practical uses across different traditions; it is not reduced here to one modern meaning.

title: Advaita Vedānta
description: A Vedānta tradition represented separately from Viśiṣṭādvaita and Dvaita, with its own textual and interpretive history.

title: Nyāya
description: A philosophical tradition associated with methods of reasoning, inference and debate. Detailed representation requires school-specific sources.

title: Sāṃkhya
description: A philosophical tradition represented here without reducing its concepts to a universal summary.

title: Vedānta
description: A family of philosophical traditions whose internal schools should be represented separately rather than as one homogeneous position.

title: Yoga Darśana
description: A philosophical school represented distinctly from the many modern and traditional uses of the word yoga.

title: Dhyāna
description: A contemplative practice term whose methods and aims vary across philosophical and living traditions.

title: Japa
description: A practice category involving repeated recitation in varied contexts; traditions differ in mantra, method and guidance.

title: Pūjā
description: A broad practice category whose forms, meanings and procedures vary by tradition, place and community. This portal does not provide universal ritual instructions here.

title: Tīrtha and pilgrimage
description: A category for pilgrimage and sacred journeys whose meanings and practices vary by place and tradition.

title: Vrata
description: A category of vows or observances whose forms and meanings vary by region, text and tradition.

title: Yajña
description: A ritual category with different textual, historical and contemporary contexts; this portal does not provide universal performance instructions.

title: Atharvaveda
description: A Vedic collection represented as a concise catalogue record. Interpretive and recensional differences require separate sourcing.

title: Bhagavad Gita
description: A sample record for a future contextual guide to a text situated within the Mahabharata. No translation or quotation is reproduced here.

title: Īśā Upaniṣad
description: A short Upaniṣadic text represented here through an original catalogue description, without reproducing a translation.

title: Mahabharata
description: A sample record for a future guide to the Mahābhārata and its textual traditions. No translation or quotation is reproduced here.

title: Rāmāyaṇa
description: An Itihāsa text with many regional and textual traditions. This record avoids collapsing those traditions into one account.

title: Rigveda
description: A concise source-aware catalogue overview. This record contains no reproduced scripture or translation.

title: Sāmaveda
description: A Vedic collection represented as a source-aware catalogue entry. Its textual and recitational traditions are not treated as identical to those of the other Vedas.

title: Yajurveda
description: A Vedic collection represented here as a concise catalogue record. Its recensions and associated textual layers require context-specific study.

title: Darśana
description: A classification for philosophical systems represented as distinct schools rather than one homogeneous position.

title: Deity traditions
description: A classification for deity-centered textual and living traditions without imposing theological hierarchy.

title: Festival traditions
description: A classification for festivals and observances whose forms vary by region, community and tradition.

title: Practice
description: A portal classification for lived practices, not a claim that all communities practice in the same way.

title: Sanskrit
description: A language and literary domain represented here through texts, terms, grammar and transmission rather than as a single uniform tradition.

title: Śruti
description: A classification used for bodies of Vedic literature and related textual traditions; its use is contextual rather than a claim that all traditions structure texts identically.

title: Upaniṣads
description: A broad category for Upaniṣadic texts, represented with attention to differences among texts, recensions and interpretations.

title: Vedāṅga
description: A classification for auxiliary disciplines associated with Vedic study; its individual domains have distinct histories and textual materials.
